主要内容: On July 2, 2018, MEDALLION FINANCIAL CORP entered into a Loan Modification Agreement with Medallion Funding LLC, Medallion Fine Art, Inc., and Sterling National Bank. The agreement amended its Amended and Restated Loan and Security Agreement dated March 28, 2011. The maturity date of the facility was extended to July 31, 2018, with other technical changes implemented. The Company and Sterling National Bank are currently negotiating a longer-term amendment to the Credit Agreement. The agreement was signed by Larry D. Hall, Chief Financial Officer, on July 5, 2018, in compliance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
